rust_summary: what a mod block entity gives the item its block drops (`native_block_entity_components`).
doc_summary:
the components a mod block entity gives the item its block drops (`native_block_entity_components`,
`BlockEntity.collectComponents`), asked as a player or an explosion breaks the block while it and its block entity are
still there, when the block's loot table copies components from its block entity (`copy_components`, source
`block_entity`). The mod names them, each as its codec writes it, and the game puts those the table copies on the item
it drops: a cooking pot keeps its meal. Server-side.

Bundles that use it need `"hooks": @API:block_entity_components@`.
